Flock.climb_binding (ms : Flock.MerkleScheme) (hs : ms.Sized) (s1 s2 : List ByteArray) (a b : ByteArray) (idx : Nat) :
s1.length = s2.length →
(∀ (x : ByteArray), x ∈ s1 → x.size = ms.digestLen) →
(∀ (x : ByteArray), x ∈ s2 → x.size = ms.digestLen) →
a.size = ms.digestLen →
b.size = ms.digestLen →
a ≠ b →
Flock.climb ms a idx s1 = Flock.climb ms b idx s2 →
Flock.MerklePair.Collides ms (Flock.climbPair ms s1 s2 a b idx)

Flock.squeeze_answers (kind : UInt8) (n : Nat) (t t' : Flock.Transcript) (coins : Array Flock.F128) (hn : n ≠ 0)
(h : Flock.Transcript.squeeze kind n t = Except.ok (coins, t')) :
t.rounds[t.k]? = some r ∧
r.n = n ∧
r.answers (t.framed kind n) ∧
coins = r.coins ∧ t' = { rounds := t.rounds, k := t.k + 1, pending := ByteArray.empty }
Flock.squeeze_retained (kind : UInt8) (n : Nat) (t t' : Flock.Transcript) (coins : Array Flock.F128) (hn : n ≠ 0)
(h : Flock.Transcript.squeeze kind n t = Except.ok (coins, t')) (r : Flock.Round) (hr : t.rounds[t.k]? = some r)
(b : ByteArray) (hb : r.bytes = some b) : t.framed kind n = b ∧ coins = r.coins
